description.value: Ocean Park Pizza & Village Pub is a family-owned restaurant and neighbourhood pub that has anchored the Ocean Park community for over 47 years, earning the 2018 South Surrey & White Rock Chamber of Commerce Medium Sized Business of the Year award. The current Craftsman-style building, opened in 2006, combines a full-service pizza and Italian-American restaurant with a pub featuring 20 beers on tap. It is open 364 days a year and well-regarded locally, having been voted best pub and best pizza in South Surrey/White Rock by multiple community readers' choice polls.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates this as a real, active, family-owned restaurant and pub at 12822 16 Avenue, Surrey, BC V4A 1N4, phone 604-536-9654, consistent across multiple pages. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('Dine in or pickup!' plus third-party delivery apps). No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null. The OSM community field says Tsawwassen but the website and address clearly place this in Ocean Park, Surrey.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Tsawwassen' but the website and postal address confirm the business is in Ocean Park, Surrey — not Tsawwassen.
OSM tags contain no address or phone; both were sourced from the website, where they appear consistently across multiple pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant and pub with confirmed address and phone. A practical and well-established dining stop for touring cyclists in the South Surrey area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The community page notes sponsorship of the Surrey Off-Road Bike Club, indicating awareness of the local cycling community.
